increment_paragraph: **SP2-SYMBOLIC-LIBRDKAFKA-PREMISES (2026-11-21).** User decision 2026-11-20 (premises are condition symbols, not sentences), launched 2026-11-21. All 220 resource_premise clauses of qcore-provider-librdkafka (12 names, 16 statements, 190 declarations in 9 modules; rk_plugin_callback_closure's 180 byte-identical clauses one formula) state C04.18.9 formulas, with a prose-to-formula table per name in the report. 75 terms are appended as C04.18.9's librdkafka block (Rust VOCABULARY, specification table, Lean vocab and Model with defaulted components), no sort, operator or typing rule added; #false is the falsum, so a negation is P -> #false and NULL-or-X is a universal over the member's designated set. The crate has no checker plugin, so its own test every_premise_is_a_formula refuses a string statement. The one exact-identity consumer, qcore-c-gateway's same-item detach representation check, holds the canonical formula and admits exactly what it admitted. 167 content-addressed binding manifests pinning a premised declaration's graph (166 rk_plugin_callback_closure, 1 detach_list_representation) were refreshed by the new premise_formula_binding_refresh tool, the graph digest each one's only change; frozen checkpoint tests read converted modules through an exact, hash-checked restoration (migration.json, tests/support/sp2_premise_checkpoint.rs). The source operator gate (Q038) reads a premise formula's | and && as the formula's own. Lean: the base module's kind lemmas no longer depend on the vocabulary's length; new QCore.PremiseFormula.Librdkafka (the 16 formulas well-formed and bound to every clause; the stated so/because consequences follow in coherent models; detach_formula_is_the_nine_atoms: the detach formula holds exactly when the nine QCore.CjsonRepresentationPremises propositions its atoms are bound to hold), audited. contracts.lock changes exactly 118 entries' contract_sha256 and pinned_at and bounds-contracts.lock 71, identities and every reviewed revision kept; the load path unchanged. No verdict reads a premise: no status move predicted on corpus, twelve-home, system or slice, content changes only where a premise statement is rendered. The nine detach_* hypothesis atoms keep their strings (SP2-DETACH-HYPOTHESES-TYPED-ATOMS).

ledger.why: DISCHARGED by SP2-SYMBOLIC-LIBRDKAFKA-PREMISES: all 220 resource_premise clauses (12 names, 16 statements) state C04.18.9 formulas with a prose-to-formula table per name; 75 new terms registered in the specification, the Rust vocabulary and the Lean vocab with their meanings; contracts.lock and bounds-contracts.lock re-pinned (118 and 71 entries, contract_sha256 and pinned_at only, identities kept) and the inventory lock synced with the reviewed diff; the crate's own test refuses a prose premise (no checker plugin exists for a shipped crate; load-time ban is SP2-SHIPPED-PROVIDER-PROSE-BAN). Premise_decomposition and flow attachments keep their atoms, refinements and flows exactly; the graph digests change only through the legacy atoms' statements, and the 167 binding manifests pinning them were refreshed with that as their only change. The nine detach_* hypothesis atoms are carried by SP2-DETACH-HYPOTHESES-TYPED-ATOMS.

ledger.title: State cJSON_DetachItemViaPointer's nine detach_* hypotheses as typed atoms
ledger.text: Recorded by SP2-SYMBOLIC-LIBRDKAFKA-PREMISES. The nine resource_hypothesis(detach_*, "...") atoms of cJSON_DetachItemViaPointer (providers/qcore-provider-librdkafka/contracts/librdkafka/cjson.qv) keep their strings: a C04.18.9 formula is a premise statement, admitted by hypothesis::validate only as a generated legacy atom's statement, and the consistent hypothesis form is C04.18.7's typed atom (quant proposition #ID(...) = FORMULA;, as the plugin_* atoms already are). DISCHARGE: each atom as a typed proposition matching its QCore.CjsonRepresentationPremises definition (the premise's formula is already proved equivalent to their conjunction, detach_formula_is_the_nine_atoms), with the cJSON binding manifest's atom digests, the nine resource_guarded_symbol_v1 clauses that repeat each atom's text, the guarded adoption plan and quirin-source-analysis::cjson_local_binding's expected graph migrated together (quant_binding_migration's typed-atom path), no verdict moved. Size: medium.

ledger.title: Refuse a prose premise at load for a shipped provider crate
ledger.text: Recorded by SP2-SYMBOLIC-LIBRDKAFKA-PREMISES. quirin-provider-openssl refuses a string premise statement at load through its checker plugin (check::prose_premise); a shipped qcore-provider-* crate has no checker plugin, so qcore-provider-librdkafka's ban is its own test (every_premise_is_a_formula), run by the provider test step, not at load. DISCHARGE: a load-time refusal for crates that opt in (for example a load-path record flag the contract loader reads, refusing a resource_premise whose statement is a string in that crate's modules, total-or-reject), applied to librdkafka and to each SP3/SP4 crate once converted, with a test per crate and no change to any crate that does not opt in. Size: small.
